note: Four layers of voxels (72, 72, 8, 8 from the back, the camera is at the front) seen end on in white. X_ITE multiplies the alpha of a sample by retainedOpacity + boundaryOpacity x f^opacityFactor where f = |voxel - the voxel one step further along the third texture axis|, the red channel only: f is zero inside a layer and only the step between layers 1 and 2 (64/255) raises the opacity. With the defaults the stack is a pale 40 in the bridge (78 in X_ITE); switched off, or with retainedOpacity 1 and boundaryOpacity 0, it is the plain dark 10 (24 in X_ITE). The difference is X_ITE's 8 bit blending of faint slices, which stalls once the alpha times the destination is under half a level, so the dark stack is lighter there; each engine is checked against its own value.
gaps: the numbers depend on the 400 slice count and the 8 bit blend of X_ITE for faint samples; the bridge adds up the same alpha in float, the tolerance is 10 levels
pow(0, 0) is hardware defined and is not tested
